info.description: Who a campaign goes to. Resolved through a single service contract — resolve(audience) -> [{ email, mergeData }] — so the 'segment' source can later point at a real crm-segment engine (ROADMAP 0.6) without touching the campaign runner.

source.description: static = the uploaded list in static_members; filter = filter_json applied to `entity`; segment = the saved crm-segment in `segment` (ROADMAP 0.6 — resolved through the whitelisted segment engine).

entity.description: Which collection a `filter` audience resolves over.

filter_json.description: Strapi filters object applied to `entity`. Recipients without a usable email are dropped by the resolver.

static_members.description: Uploaded list: [{ email, mergeData: {...} }]. Used when source = 'static'.

merge_mapping.description: Merge key -> source field, e.g. { first_name: 'name', company: 'company' }. The RMAILX staging-slot idea, with named keys instead of CUSTOM1..9.

member_count.description: Cached count from the last resolve. Advisory only — the runner always re-resolves.

segment.description: The saved CRM segment this audience resolves through when source = 'segment'. Ignored for the other sources.
